[{"op": "add", "path": "/project", "value": {"name": "Client Portal Rollout"}}]

[{"op": "add", "path": "/schedule", "value": {"start_date": "2025-04-07"}}]
Make the kickoff and requirements review the first activity, lasting 2 workdays from the project start.

Have that first activity wrap up on April 9, 2025, so the next work can begin then.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/tasks/0/finish_date", "value": "2025-04-09"}]

[{"op": "add", "path": "/tasks/1/predecessor", "value": "Kickoff and Requirements Review"}]

[{"op": "add", "path": "/tasks/-", "value": {"name": "Backend API Setup", "duration_days": 4, "start_date": "2025-04-14"}}]

[{"op": "add", "path": "/tasks/2/finish_date", "value": "2025-04-18"}, {"op": "add", "path": "/tasks/2/predecessor", "value": "UX Wireframes"}]
Then put frontend integration after the API setup, as a 5-workday effort starting on April 18, 2025.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/tasks/-", "value": {"name": "Frontend Integration", "duration_days": 5, "start_date": "2025-04-18"}}]
Set frontend integration to finish on April 25, 2025, and tie it to the backend API setup.

After that, add QA testing as a 3-workday task starting when frontend integration finishes.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/tasks/-", "value": {"name": "QA Testing", "duration_days": 3, "start_date": "2025-04-25"}}]
Have QA testing finish on April 30, 2025, and make it depend on frontend integration.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/tasks/4/finish_date", "value": "2025-04-30"}, {"op": "add", "path": "/tasks/4/predecessor", "value": "Frontend Integration"}]
Add the production launch preparation after QA, lasting 2 workdays and starting on April 30, 2025.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/tasks/-", "value": {"name": "Production Launch Preparation", "duration_days": 2, "start_date": "2025-04-30"}}]
Show the launch prep finishing on May 2, 2025, and link it after QA testing.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/tasks/5/finish_date", "value": "2025-05-02"}, {"op": "add", "path": "/tasks/5/predecessor", "value": "QA Testing"}]
Now summarize the plan with the total number of activities and the final completion date.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/schedule/task_count", "value": 6}, {"op": "add", "path": "/schedule/project_end_date", "value": "2025-05-02"}]
Add Maya Chen from Customer Success as the business sponsor for this rollout.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/stakeholders", "value": [{"name": "Maya Chen", "role": "Business Sponsor", "team": "Customer Success"}]}]

theme: Inserting a task into the schedule

risks.description: Single sign-on approval may take longer than expected

conversation_pattern: Center the artifact on a task list where each task has a stated duration and starts when its predecessor finishes, so finishes derive along the precedence chain, rolling up to a task count and a project end. Around this core, add the realistic, independent details a project plan would carry that do not depend on the schedule dates, and vary their number and the number of tasks from sample to sample.
edit_pattern: Insert one new task with a specific duration at a specific point in the precedence chain.
cascade_pattern: Inserting a task shifts every downstream task later by the inserted duration, raises the task count by one, and moves the project end. Tasks before the insertion point stay. This is determined because durations and links are stated.
